booking_link.subject: Your call with {agencyName}
booking_link.heading: Choose a time for the call
booking_link.body:
Hello {firstName}, thank you for applying.

The call lasts 45 minutes and helps us understand your context before any proposal. Choose the time that suits you best. The link is valid until {expiresOn}.

booking_confirmed.subject: Call booked: {startsAtLabel}
booking_confirmed.heading: Your call is booked
booking_confirmed.body:
Hello {firstName}, your call with {agencyName} is booked for {startsAtLabel}.

If you need to change the time or cancel, use the button below up to 2 hours before.

call_reminder.subject: Reminder: call with {agencyName}
call_reminder.heading: Your call is coming up
call_reminder.body: Hello {firstName}, this is a reminder of your call with {agencyName} on {startsAtLabel}.

booking_cancelled.subject: Call cancelled

booking_cancelled.body:
Hello {firstName}, your call with {agencyName} was cancelled.

If you want to book another time, use the button below.

session_confirmed.subject: Proposal session: {startsAtLabel}

session_confirmed.body:
Hello {firstName}, the session where {agencyName} presents what we found and what we propose is booked for {startsAtLabel}.

It takes sixty minutes, with whoever decides.

session_reminder.subject: Reminder: session with {agencyName}
session_reminder.heading: The session is coming up
session_reminder.body: Hello {firstName}, a reminder of the proposal session with {agencyName} booked for {startsAtLabel}.

If anything is not right, let us know.

presentation_shared.body: Hello {firstName}, the presentation from our session is now in the portal, to review at your own pace or share with whoever decides with you.

contract_signed.subject: Agreement signed
contract_signed.heading: Agreement signed
contract_signed.body: Hello {firstName}, the agreement is signed by both parties. The signed PDF is in the portal.

payment_requested.body:

The invoice is issued once the payment is received.

If you have already paid, please ignore this message.

If you have already paid, please ignore this message: the confirmation follows once the payment is reconciled.
